topic_title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro Model

social_post.short_version: Moonshot AI's new Kimi K3.1 Pro features a 1-million-token context window and a ~3-trillion-parameter architecture, while deliberately curbing its hacking skills to navigate the growing dilemma of balancing model power with cybersecurity risks.
social_post.long_version: The release of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro highlights a central dilemma facing modern artificial intelligence development: how to scale model capabilities without amplifying cybersecurity risks. Unveiled on October 24, the open-weight model features a ~3-trillion-parameter architecture (2.8T total and 104B active MoE parameters) alongside a 1-million-token context window, scoring 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and approaching the performance of Claude Opus 5.5 on internal tests. Notably, the startup deliberately limited the model's hacking capabilities ahead of its full weight release planned for November. This strategic constraint underscores the complex choices researchers and developers navigate when balancing raw computational power with safe deployment practices in open-weight environments.
